description: Phase B CM1 validation-anchor case for low-cloud behavior in a very moist shallow stable layer.
physical_question: How can a very moist, shallow stable lower atmosphere produce low stratus-like cloud?
expected_outcome: Low stratus-like low cloud develops near the lower atmosphere.
expected_regime: Low stratus-like low cloud develops near the lower atmosphere.

namelist_input_concept.forcing_concept: Weak surface heating and moisture supply over a near-saturated shallow stable layer.

sounding_profile_concept.format_reference: CM1 input_sounding format: first line surface pressure, theta, qv; following lines z, theta, qv, u, v.
sounding_profile_concept.free_atmosphere: Near-saturated shallow layer below a stable drying profile to favor low-cloud rather than deep cumulus.
sounding_profile_concept.final_level_note: Final sounding level is above ztop/grid top.

expected_output_files: cm1out_stats.nc or cm1out_stats.dat/ctl depending on CM1 output settings
required_fields: pressure or pressure-derived metadata if available
diagnostics_to_compute: low cloud base/top or near-surface cloud depth

do_not_commit: runtime support files such as LANDUSE.TBL

how_to_ingest: After local output exists, use scripts/reference/cm1/run_validation_batch.sh --execute or scripts/reference/cm1/ingest_cm1_output.py with this case id to map selected output into reference-run-v1/reference-frame-v1 data.
known_limitations: This is named low stratus because the setup uses weak heating and shallow stability rather than a full radiative-cooling fog design.
Do not claim fog unless output is surface-attached and the setup supports that label.
First-pass configuration may need calibration after output inspection.
notes: CM1 is offline reference-model output; Cloud Lab does not run CM1 in normal app sessions.
No generated CM1 output is committed with this manifest.
Validation status remains planned until real local output is generated, ingested, and manually inspected.
